- **Hide partner photos when you want:** the Timeline's View menu has a new Partner photos switch. Turn it off to see only your own photos; photos in albums your partner made still show. Settings › Sharing › Show partner albums lets you leave partner albums out of your album list too. Nothing is deleted, and turning either back on shows everything again.
- **Big libraries open faster:** Albums and Explore no longer stall on very large libraries. Explore opens straight away and fills in landmarks when they're ready.
- **Favorites shows Locked items after you unlock:** unlocking now reveals your Locked favorites, as Timeline and Archive already did.
- **Groundwork for two-step sign-in:** the server can now ask for a code from an authenticator app after your password, with recovery codes for a lost phone. The screens to turn it on arrive in a later update.
- **Manager:** buttons show a spinner while their action runs, and a release that fails verification now records why in the Manager log.
